claim_boundary: No successful-compromise lead-time claim is certified until V98 has an integrity-pinned model warning, an objective successful-compromise event for the same campaign, positive lead time, and complete campaign-disjointness provenance.

legacy_evidence_excluded.reason: V93 measures lead time to an attack-step/onset boundary. An attack-step/onset timestamp is not an objective successful-compromise timestamp.

repository_audit.audit_conclusion: The active branch does not currently contain a paired objective successful-compromise event and model-warning event that satisfies the V98 contract.

required_for_pass: Select one explicitly identified evidence campaign and prove its identity is disjoint from train, validation, calibration, and development-reused campaign identities.
Record an actual model-emitted warning event with a timezone-aware timestamp and emitted_by_model=true.
Record an objective successful-compromise event for the same campaign with a timezone-aware timestamp and establishes_successful_compromise=true.
Integrity-pin both raw JSON event artifacts by SHA-256.
Verify that successful_compromise_timestamp - model_warning_timestamp is strictly greater than zero.
Keep the certified claim scoped only to the exact campaign represented by those artifacts.
